title: Missoula County Crash Explorer

source.coordinate_recovery: Coordinates are MDT's own, read directly from the Crash table's X and Y columns (EPSG:32100) and reprojected to WGS84. MDT added these columns to the published decade release in October 2026; earlier extracts required recovering them by a Crash ID join to the Vehicle and Person tables.

scope.name: Missoula
scope.label: Missoula County
scope.note: This bundle covers one county. Intersection clusters are derived from crashes inside it, so the comparison is between this county's roads rather than against the state.
scope.boundary: Crashes are included by the county recorded on the report, so a route is cut at the Missoula County line.

severity_coding.caveat: Missoula County records 6.2 suspected-serious injuries per fatality against 3.71 statewide. Fatality is not a judgement call; suspected serious is, and it is not coded to one threshold across Montana. Any ranking that counts fatal-plus-serious is therefore partly measuring reporting practice.

attribution: Analysis of MDT public crash data. Not an MDT product; not endorsed by MDT.
section_407: The source workbooks carry a 23 U.S.C. 407 notice. Section 407 is an evidentiary rule: data compiled for identifying or evaluating highway safety improvements is not subject to discovery and is not admissible in an action for damages arising at a location the data addresses. It is reproduced here as provenance, not as a restriction on this bundle.
disclaimer: This dashboard is an independent analysis of public crash data published by the Montana Department of Transportation. It is not an MDT product and is not endorsed by MDT. Crash records are administrative data collected by investigating officers: they contain errors and omissions, they are coded to the reporting standards of the year they were filed, and fields describing driver condition record an officer's field assessment rather than any adjudicated or laboratory finding. Counts for the most recent year may be incomplete. Nothing here establishes the cause of any crash, the condition of any road, or the conduct of any person.

disclosure_policy.rule: Publish no more precision than MDT already publishes, on any axis the dashboard does not need.

city.label: City or town
city.desc: City/town from the crash report; null for crashes outside an incorporated place (55% of records).

kabco.label: Severity (KABCO)
kabco.desc: K fatal, A suspected serious, B suspected minor, C possible injury, O property damage only, U unknown.

hotspot_id.label: Intersection cluster
hotspot_id.desc: Derived cluster of intersection-related crashes; -1 where the crash is not intersection-related or its cluster is too small to rank. Not a surveyed intersection -- see meta.hotspots.

corridor.label: MDT corridor
corridor.desc: MDT's "Corridor Name" field. It holds an opaque identifier (C000007, C008128), not a road name, and the published extract ships no table to resolve one into the other. It groups crashes onto the same stretch of road reliably; it does not tell you which road that is.

lon.label: Longitude
lon.desc: WGS84. See coord_source for where this build's coordinates came from.

person_K.label: Fatal injuries
person_K.desc: People with a fatal injury. Coded independently of crash severity; the two disagree on 10 of 219,480 records (see master_manifest.json).

is_ka.label: Fatal or serious
is_ka.desc: KABCO K or A. The standard severity screening measure.

is_intersection.label: Intersection-related
is_intersection.desc: Junction relation is an intersection, intersection-related, crossover-related, or driveway/alley access related.

is_vru.label: Vulnerable road user
is_vru.desc: Pedestrian or bicycle involved. Union of the crash-level collision type and a non-motorist person record -- neither source alone is complete.

motorcycle_involved.label: Motorcycle involved
motorcycle_involved.desc: A vehicle with a motorcycle body type.

heavy_truck_involved.label: Heavy truck involved
heavy_truck_involved.desc: Medium/heavy truck body type, or GVW over 26,000 lb.

alcohol_suspected.label: Alcohol suspected
alcohol_suspected.desc: Derived from the investigating officer's field assessment on the crash report. This is not a toxicology result, a charge, or a conviction, and it may be incorrect. Do not read it as a factual finding of impairment.

unrestrained_occupant.label: Unrestrained occupant
unrestrained_occupant.desc: At least one occupant recorded as using no restraint.

occupant_ejected.label: Occupant ejected
occupant_ejected.desc: At least one occupant partially or totally ejected.

is_wildlife.label: Wildlife involved
is_wildlife.desc: Collision with a wild animal. Union of the crash-level Collision Type and the First Harmful Event detail, which disagree on 508 crashes. Domestic animals and livestock are coded separately by MDT and are NOT included. Wildlife crashes are common but rarely severe: 0.79% are fatal or suspected-serious against 3.66% statewide.

hotspots.method: Intersection-related crashes snapped to a 40 m grid; cells with at least 3 crashes become clusters. Not surveyed intersections -- a cluster is a place where crashes coincide, which usually but not always means one junction.
